Definition: a stride, i.e. (by euphemism) the crotch
BiblicalUsage: The word is a stride, named by euphemism for the crotch, and it appears once, when Hanun shamed David's ambassadors by cutting off their garments in the midst and sending them away.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the shame was deliberate: Hanun wanted the whole region to see that he despised David, and the war that followed was the price of the insult.
